This '''raid''' was a minor skirmish during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It mainly involved an attempt by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Noric Gestal]] and his [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Noric Gestal's gang|gang]] to capture a number of [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] staff in the [[Fungus Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and sell them into slavery. The attempt failed, however, and the staff members were saved by the [[Heroes of Cularin]] and some other patrons in the cantina.
